g.text: Local CPU: Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C · shared-host provisional timings
Boxes: workload IQR and median; whiskers: full range; dots: exact requests. GM and n are per backend/panel.
FFT: GPU0, final library a00188ff…; other panels: GPU1, original library 3b0668f2…. No pooled cohort/build mean.
GPU: warm CUDA Graph, 7 × 20 complete calls, 10 warmups; CPU: wall-clock, same repeats. Initial transfers excluded.
Integer outputs exact. Three GPU-NTT forward failures have no GPU ratio; own and replay independently exact.
Floating results remain accuracy-review-required. HadaCore FP16 is outside Full66 FP32/FP64; see separate MMA9 panel.
CPU/GPU values include required adapters; word32 HEXL is storage adapted. Request identities and all gaps are in the tables.
